data: I finally finished it again, its a great time, great story, 10/10 would recommend
A really fun and beautiful game, I would highly recommend you play it if you haven't
Very fun game the graphics, lore, and gameplay are really good
Soundtrack is awesome and the story is so good
Devs lied about macOS support, is unplayable on a Mac
A game that prevents you from progressing simply because the developers limited the gameplay to a single, hard-to-find path is exhausting, boring, and irritating

I didn't think a game could make me lose interest in Fallout 4. Now while my friends are talking about OP guns and raider encounters all I can bring to the conversation is how much table coral I stored the other day.

(Update 8/4/17)

The full game is near finish. I have to give the developers credit on staying focused and delivering amazing new content each update. It's now often to see early access game devs add dlc/season pass stuff while the actual game has not been finished. These devs care about the fans 100%. I will stick with whatever new content and or games they create in the future.

With that said, I'm gonna take another dive again :)

BIG ADVICE: DO NOT LOOK AT THE MAP THAT'S UPLOADED ON THE INTERNET, IT WILL COMPLETELY RUIN THE EXPIRIENCE.

That is all I can say, if you don't do this then the game is an immense expirience that will leave you wanting for more every time you exit the game. There is so much to explore and find. It's definitely worth picking up!

I did the mistake and looked at the map after like 10hours of playtime to find the hidden entrance of one of the secrets I was aware of.
THIS COMPLETELY KILLED THE IMMERSION AND THE GAME. I now know the entire map and it pulled almost the entire excitement out of it.

This game is so awesome that it ruined my life.

I got so immersed, that I would stay up until 4 am playing. I would fall asleep at work the next day. I continued to neglect my 3 children, but even harder. This game is so sweet, that anyone who plays it instantly looks 27 times hotter. I met someone who also played it, and we binged all the other games together, while occasionally sleeping with each other during Gamer breaks.

My boring wife didn't stand a chance. It couldn't be helped. Too bad she found out. But that's okay, because at least I still have Subnautica.

Let me start off by saying, this game is amazing. I have spent hours on hours playing this game, they keep adding storyline witch is amazing to watch unfold, it's as if your playing an interactive story. While at the same time there is a massive free world aspect to it. You can go looking for one item, then get distracted, and only rember 3 hours later what you wanted to do. There is that much to do. While I enjoyed the game, I played it on my laptop so it had some serious fps issues. I'm pretty sure its my computer but a warning to buyer, if you don't have a computer that can run games like this at good fps, then this won't be any different. Overall though this game is amazing and it's an awesome experience to go through the development with others.

Edit: Redid the review

Subnautica is totally worth the money. This game has probably 2-3 days or more worth of play time, and even more if you don't rush through it. Trust me when I say explore all you can in this game, find every fish, every wreck, every biome. There is so much to see in this game on an alien world, and the biomes and creatures are so creative and diverse. I would give this game a 10/10.

I mean, what can I really say? This game is an amazing take on the survival game genre, and you need to do something different for me to take notice.

Biggest stand-out is the beautiful alien ocean that you get to explore. But of course, to some of you, that might be absolutely terrifying...

This is probably one of the best exploration games out there, im having high hopes for the full version of it!

Pros:

1. A lot to discover

2. Working submarines

3. Amazing (and creepy) places to explore

4. Good looking visuals/graphics

5. A lot of stuff to interact with

6. Daily updates!

Cons:

1. Optimization.

2. Not much help granted on your first ever gameplay

9,6 out of 10 for me on this game!

One of the best survival game ive played after a long time, the progression might be a bit slow for some players but if you love a survival game with explorations and discovering new things every day, then it wont feel that slow.

Great game. Good fun. Probably really replayable but I'm gonna play my unfinished games first. 
Worked great on LinuxMint with a 1660 GTX Super
Still in the middle of it but the sense of exploration and terror is so goddamn amazingly done

It's like No Man's Sky but underwater only and not procedural. Gather to build and survive, explore, with a general overarching mission to work towards too. You probably know you'll like it or not already, just get it if you're thinking about it.

The less you know about the game the better it is when you jump into it. Give it a try if you havent, its one of my favorites of all times, and it dosent require a really beefy computer, im playing it on my school pc.

I think this is a great game to play. There is a bug where when you enter the seamoth, it kinda freezes but other than that it's fantastic. If you love minecraft, I can assure you that you'll love this!

Its a very good Survival/Exploration game. I myself have thalassophobia (fear of the sea/deep waters) but i still enjoy the game a lot. If you are planning to buy a survival game i would say this is a really good choice.

Subnautica is in my top ten favourite games, the scenery and the pace of the game are amazing. If is by far my favourite survival game, despite me hating the ocean.
Resource gathering never seems too annoying or boring as you are constantly scared of strange looking fish. I also love this game for its optimization, despite some lag issues, my computer can actually handle some of its highest settings unlike most games on pc which look worse and have a worse fps.

I Can Taste the water and hear the scream from the damn leviathan in my dream
10/10 My Thalassophobia is Back with vengeance

tried it during free weekend and that's more than enough

this game has a very deep lore and is great if you like open world single player games. definitely would recommend. please not that the game can be scary at times but you just have to commit, once you get past the scary part, it really is beautiful.

I have played many games on the Steam console, but I rarely leave a review. I had to with Subnautica. Obsessed! The amazing environment is very immersive. It has good replayability, and remains exciting. Overall, great game and I look forward to playing many more run throughs.

I have some kind of sick fetish for underwater or alien settings, this game combines them perfectly. I don't even like survival games, but this one is worth playing. Cruising around in a giant mobile base submarine and jumping into your docked mini ship to explore the depths below is peak gaming. Below zero is awful but THIS game is incredible. Get it. Mod it. Ignore the VR version. If something annoys you, there's a mod for it.
Great game but i wish they would add a dlc to it to expand it without making a whole new game

If you want a game where you have to spend most of your time being scared for your life and thinking about your chances of getting murdered by a Reaper, well then. You've come to the right place! (Trust me, I have experience.)

But let me get to the point, this game's soundtrack is AMAZING! It's so immersive, and you can feel the atmosphere. There was a lot of care that went into the creation of this game and the creators are still making it better!

(Please save me from these Reapers..)

This game is absolutly beautiful. Sure it's still early access but as it is it's pretty good. This game is already amazing and has a massive amount of potential. Please keep working on this and please keep coming out with more updates.

This honestly is a great game!Got it today (10/10/21) and i love it.
The game has a excellent horror theme to it and a large free roam world with many things to do.
The best part in my opinion is just how creative bases can be, it is a great feature.
You can't forget grinding. Grinding in this game is not actually boring (to a point) and is really fun!
Every action feels like it gives you a reward.

This game was gifted to me by my best friend and i can not thank them enough.
ADIOS!

Subnautica is the kind of game that drags you to the deep end (literally)

The gameplay element of it is amazing, the whole premise of crash landing on an alien planet is very exciting.
From the minecraft style of gathering resources to the HUD and PDA system, everything just works perfect!

Ive never had problems with grahpics, crashing. I can run the game on high settings with about 120 fps (gtx970, i5, 16gb ram)

As for the story, ive been following the content updates that add story elements very closesly.
I have played through the newly added voice of the deep update and lets just say, the ending of that had me shed a tear (The story is not fully implemented yet!)

Overal score: Solid 9/10

For the first Run Sunbeam been fkup. I rescue myself........
For the second Run Sunbeam safe but due to debris they can't rescue me so......I rescue myself AGAIN.

Anyway, overall it is a GOOD GAME.

The only thing I think would make this game more fun... is make it multiplayer. I would love to explore around with a friend. Multiplayer would make this game IMHO perfect. its fun, lots to explore and overall a great time. Just after 26 hours I got bored by myself.. and played a diffrent game with some friends.

Deep survival gameplay with a unique blend of emergent and scripted story all in a large and lovingly handcrafted world. Avoids some of the more tedious aspects of other games in the genre (unless you decide to build a very large base which is not required), I always felt I was making progress and building/discovering new things even if I only had time to play for 30 minutes. 10/10

Okay so...Subnautica is, to me, the scariest game I've ever played. And my fear of water definitely doesn't help the fact that this game is meant as a fun, exploration, survival game. I'm not saying it's bad, dear god it is beautiful and fun, but I am horrified by these underwater creatures and the thing that scares me is when I go into very open areas and I see and hear this giant tentacle creature just swimming right above my head. And no, there isn't just one of them...there are a dozen of them...But, overall, this is a great game and I would recommend it to anybody who likes survival games.

great game but a bit laggy on MacBook but otherwise i love it my favorite part is building bases in creative mode the reaper leviathan scared the crap out of me hard to get in and out if the deep cave where the fanal objective is with cyclops i almost lost mine.

Finally got around to playing this on my backburner, and I got sick of it the thousandth time I had to go up for air. Do I have a scuba tank or a ziplock with a straw attached? Plus all I have to store my shit are little shoeboxes floating around my base?
Yeah no thanks. Shelved

Was honestly better during the beta they kinda lost the charm.

The grandeur and sense of scale was lost.

But it's still subnautica so play it. Mods for this game are great.
the game has a lot of potential, adventure, a little horror:> and the story is a bit okay. I like this game but I didn't get a chance to finish it BUUT, I like it

Easily one of the most surprising games I played this year. For the very first second it pulls you in with a beautiful terrifying underwater setting like I have never experience before. it's throwing you deep in the water and like the protagonist you need to figure out how to survive, maintain oxygen, eat , drink and build habitats and ships.
It's one of the most thrilling games I ever played.

Absolutely amazing game! Combines some great graphics with really immersive gameplay and a really interesting storyline. The accompanying soundtrack and interesting creatures can provide a very tense atmosphere that makes you want to play more and more, but overall one of my favourite games to date. very strongly recommend

I first got this game for free through the Epic Games store back in 2018. I didn't think much of it when I first downloaded it, but it very quickly became something I really looked forward to every time I came home from my summer job at the time. I was hooked. Beating it left me with a sadness that actually weighed on my chest.

Subnautica has one of the best progression trajectories out of any game I've played. It's well-designed, immensely satisfying, and intertwines with the story masterfully. The vehicles are fabulous, and the base building mechanic is top notch. The game world is expansive and diverse, with areas ranging from absolutely gorgeous to downright terrifying. The exploration aspect was easily one of my favourite things about the game when I first picked it up.

My main gripe is how buggy the game is, even after all these years. There's a tonne of bugs in seemingly every aspect of the game (including the game's music system!), although ultimately they don't take away from the experience too much. This is just something to be wary of.

Overall, I'd absolutely recommend this game to anyone. 8/10
Awesome graphics some times lags and in some parts kind of creepy because you can't see the bottom that much.

I don't think any game I've played has gotten a reaction from me like Subnautica has.

While diving for some scrap metals, at about 20 hrs into the game, a Stalker managed to sneak up to me and bite a chunk out of my butt. I jumped out of my skin as, at this point of the game, I was used to simply ignoring them. I was so shocked that I used my stasis rifle on it and cut it to ribbons using my combat knife.

This is the part that separates this game from the others, I felt terrible for over reacting and butchering it because it got the jump on me. All it was doing was protecting its territory.

I've finished the game now and it was an experience I would highly recommend to others. It really is that good.

Just one last thing, go into the game blind - don't read wiki's or any other tips, you'll thank me for it later.

This game is the game. Originally I got this game due to my fear of Open Water... but man this game is the game, I keep coming back for more and more, It has tons of content and nice gameplay.

So basically you're the survivor of an intergalatic crash on an aquatic planet (99% water)
So now using your great advanced technology you must make the best of it and survive by making this place your new home! Explore vast biomes and reclaim pieces of technology in order to explore the vast reaches of this rich planet!

Survival, You need to eat and drink
Exploration, recover pieces of technology to expand your base and give comfort to your life.
Action, all kinds of sea creatures from hostile to docile, which one is which? Guess you'll have to see.
Story, uncover the mystery of the Aurora Crash
Roman... there's no romance, yaarhh fiddle me timbers, fall in love with the ocean!

It's a great game, really woth its price.
Great graphics, great contents and the developers keep adding BIG content in updates.

Go ahead, give it a try!

Subnautica offers an enjoyable and atmospheric experience in a gorgeous world with a unique setting. The sound design is stellar and the story does a good enough job of motivating you to explore the world to see and do what the game has to offer. It does sadly suffer from quite subpar writing, as the story really stops to make sense once viewed past face value, and the game mechanics and performance often leaves a lot to be desired. Overall an enjoyable, if technically flawed, experience that's entirely reasonable given the asking price.

This game was good in standard play. The devs are great for adding seamless VR at no additional charge. This game in VR is what VR is supposed to be. Very immursive, you feel like your there swimming with the alien creatures. This may be one of the best VR games out there today. If you get motion sickness, grow a set and play this game. A little sea sickness never killed anyone.

Subnautica is a very unique game. It is a game that will inspire so many different games and it is a perfect mix of fantasy and survival. In order to survive you must build bases, submarines, other tools. There is so much potential to this game and I completely look forward to what they will add. I've played 3 hours of the game before writing this and I already have encountered very few bugs, if any. I have not tried the base building yet but I am completely in love with the Cyclops and the seamoth. Currently the only two vehicles in the game but both extremely useful in their own ways. The cyclops is the largest vehicle, able to suck in the seamoth as to bring it along with it do discover and explore new areas and creatures. Personally I believe that the game should be a little more complicated in the sense of different resources and requirements for building. I like a tough game but some people do not. All around I believe this game has amazing potential, I look forward to future updates and upgrades, and also I would absolutely LOVE to see a multiplayer feature! Just saying!

This game is an absolute gem of a game, the story I think the story is absolutely amazing, the fact that (SPOILER WARNING!) you land on an alien planet and explore the world beneath you is extraordinary, (THE NEXT SPOILER IS EVEN BIGGER WARNING!) when you find the lost river and explore the green the surroundings around you you is amazing. 2 things that I think are the absolute best about this game is that you can build vehicles to go around the world in, and the fact that when you start the game, you think all you have to do is survive a couple of weeks and someone will rescue you, (SPOILER) and then you find out about ancient aliens and that you have to cure yourself before leaving the water planet is amazing. 11/10 for this game.

I haven't put too much time into this game, but with what I've put into it now, I must say, I love it.

I've played quite a few "survival" games, but this one finally opens up for me, being lost in an alien world almost completely engolfed in a vast ocean is wild.

I'm not so great with writing reviews, so I'll try and just say, I really enjoy this game and what it has to offer. They seem to be updating it quite a lot and with each update, they seem to hold something brand new to the game.

I'm really looking forward to the future of this game guys, you're doing great.

I was having fun till the 2023 beta got removed, and ALL of my mods can no longer work bc the 2025 version is terrible for modding.

(EDIT) As time went on though when 2025 became more compatible with mods (but not all of them) i was able to play with them again. I fully understand why they did what they did but at the time it was almost impossible to find out how to downgrade for a normal person.

As a whole even without mods this game SLAPS i have spent days in this game both on pc and vr just playing and base building
go behind the aurora for extra loot early game and listen to music while playing

+ Stable enough
+ Already contains a bunch of content
+ A lot of NOPE.
+ Devs actually developing game and there's even a trello dashboard to check current status and plans.
+ Music is atmospheric
- Poor optimization
- Sometimes introduce quite nasty bugs.
Recommended? Yes. For everyone? No. Not for guys who ready to deal with bad optimization and bugs and scary NOPE as well.

I loved Subnautica so much; it’s one of my favorite games (def top 10) I highly recommend giving it a go it truly is worth the experience. The exploration, the map, and the design of the biomes are incredibly entertaining to explore. It’s one of the best exploration games I’ve seen so far, and I honestly don’t have any complaints.

Fantastic game. It really nails down the spirit of exploration, and the base building feels very purposeful. The feeling of slowly getting familiar to your neighborhood, and expanding the areas you are familiar with little by little is amazing.

Do yourself a favor, and do not spoil yourself when playing this game:
- Get some pen and paper, take notes, write down landmarks, sketch a map. The game area is not that large, and getting lost is temporary.
- Do not worry about losing resources to death or misuse -- there are more than enough resources to cover for your mistakes.

Take it easy, take breaks if you feel stuck, and let the game become your home for a few weeks.

I really like dipping my toes into the alien oceanic waters of Subnautica. Great survival game with all the trade mark things to do, as in get water, get food, keep warm and build stuff - oh and swim away from that big farting fish!

Great game highly recommend it if your into survival games.

Best way to sum Subnautica up: a fantastic experience, not just a game.

Survival at its finest with water, food, health and oxygen while you explore an underwater world. Use your PDA to provide you vital information regarding the fantastic story. Scan everything and see what it has to say and use it to find your eay through the game.

It's exploration forefront makes this world so fun! I have absolutely enjoyed seeing what materials I can find and craft, and uncover what happened and why we are here in the first place, and how to get back home.

No combat necessary, as part of the thrill is navigating through and around predators as you sink further into the depths.

Also wanted to note the basebuilding is *chefs kiss*.

Plays very well with very little frame drops on Steam Deck. Some new areas take a second to load in, but it's worth the wait with the gorgeous visuals.

Hope you enjoy it as much as I have!
